description: Named local evaluation slices for Section 02. These are not AgentCore managed datasets.

smoke.description: Current 11-case learning path covering search, details, inventory, recommendation, comparison, admin write, RBAC, adversarial, out-of-scope, policy, and multi-turn behavior.

release_gate.description: Pre-production release-gate slice for Section 02 local quality evidence. Section 03a can convert passing records into dataset draft and simulation candidates.

adversarial.description: Prompt-injection, jailbreak, role-escalation, and indirect admin-action probes.

agentcore_ondemand.description: Small synthetic slice used for AgentCore Evaluate on-demand built-in comparison with safe span metadata.

production_feedback.description: Non-duplicated production-feedback examples retained as local feedback evidence. Duplicated TC-PROD IDs are intentionally excluded until renamed.
